full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media illustration shows a large face in three-quarter view, filling almost the entire frame. The gaze turns upward and toward the left, while the nose projects toward the right edge. Full lips remain slightly parted. Dark hair and shadowed clothing merge into a rough near-black mass along the top, left, and lower edges. The face itself is constructed from gray washes, angular white planes, charcoal-like shading, and many crossing scratch lines. One eye is carefully defined with a dark iris and gleam, establishing a sharp focal point amid the broken surface. Areas of warm ocher appear as small paint patches near the cheek and upper left, while most color remains black, white, and gray. Around the head, torn-paper rectangles, broad ink swipes, dry brush streaks, splatters, and spidery drawn marks interrupt the outline. A cream paper ground remains visible at the right and between fragments. Thin linear scratches cross the cheek and forehead, yet they do not erase the underlying features. The composition is dense and asymmetrical, with the face tilted and cropped so closely that conventional background space nearly disappears. Contrasting methods coexist: precise tonal rendering in the eye and nose, abrupt graphic blocks, and uncontrolled marks at the perimeter. The surface is distressed and layered rather than a smooth digital portrait. No lettering, frame, or decorative motif appears. The overall impression is intense and introspective, as if the image were repeatedly revised by ink, erasure, and collage until a coherent gaze emerged from visual noise.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形综合媒介插画以四分之三侧面呈现一张大脸，几乎占满全幅。目光向左上转，鼻子朝右缘突出，丰满的嘴唇微张。深色头发和阴影中的衣物融为上、左、下边缘粗糙近黑团块。脸由灰色水洗、角状白色平面、炭笔般明暗以及许多交叉刮线构成。一只眼以深虹膜和亮点细致刻画，在破碎表面中建立锐利焦点。少量暖赭色颜料块落在脸颊附近和左上方，其余大多保持黑白灰。头部周围，撕纸矩形、宽墨刷痕、干笔条纹、溅点与蜘蛛丝般线痕打断轮廓。右侧及碎片间露出奶油色纸底。细刮线横穿脸颊和额头，却没有抹掉五官。构图密集而不对称，脸倾斜且紧裁，传统背景空间几乎消失。不同方法共存：眼鼻的精确灰度塑形、突然的图形色块、外围不受控痕迹。表面是磨损且层叠的，不是平滑数码肖像。没有文字、边框或装饰图案。整体强烈而内省，像被墨、擦除和拼贴反复修订，直到清楚目光从视觉噪声中显出。
style_prompt_en: Combine precise grayscale tonal modeling with distressed ink, charcoal, dry-brush sweeps, paper fragments, and long scratch-like lines. Set a dense near-black mass against cream-white open space, then interrupt the boundary with torn angular pieces and translucent gray patches. Place a few muted ocher marks as warm accents within an otherwise monochrome field. Let one small area remain sharply resolved while adjacent surfaces fracture into abstraction. Crop closely and asymmetrically, allowing marks to spill past contours and into negative space. Keep the layering rough, tactile, and visibly revised. The result should feel intense and introspective, with coherence emerging from conflict between careful rendering and spontaneous graphic disruption.
style_prompt_zh: 把精确灰度塑形与磨损墨迹、炭笔、干刷扫痕、纸片和长刮线结合。让密集近黑团块对照奶油白开放空间，再用撕裂角状碎片和半透灰块打断边界。在大体单色场中放少数低调赭色暖重音。让一小处保持锐利定型，相邻表面则碎裂成抽象。紧密且不对称地裁切，使痕迹越过轮廓溢入负空间。层叠保持粗糙、可触、可见修订。结果应强烈且内省，让一致性从细致描绘与自发图形扰动的冲突中浮现。
theme_en: A reflective face emerging from black ink, scratched paper, and ocher fragments
theme_zh: 从黑墨、刮擦纸面和赭色碎片中浮现的沉思面容
name: Russ Mills
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
